prompts.claude:
Create ONE desktop pet sprite, with a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Reference 1 is the EXACT intended art style and body proportions: the little blue-haired DeepSeek desktop pet in the center of that image. Reference 2 supplies ONLY Claude's character identity.
Draw Claude in the SAME flat hand-drawn 2D chibi game-sprite style as reference 1: approximately 2 heads tall, extremely short compact body, round head, tiny feet and mitten-like hands, thick crisp dark outlines, large simple expressive eyes, flat cel-shaded color blocks with at most 2 shadow tones, short round silhouette that reads at 140px. This must look like a sibling desktop pet from the SAME sprite pack as reference 1.
Claude identity: long pumpkin-orange hair simplified into compact rounded locks, orange flower hairclip, warm brown eyes, ivory/navy dress with orange center panel and one orange flower brooch, tiny brown book. Preserve these recognizable signature features. Full body front view, small calm smile, relaxed standing idle pose, all hair and accessories inside image. One subject, centered, filling about 80% of square canvas height, 10% padding. No text, logos, scenery, floor or pedestal.
Do NOT copy the adult anatomy or long slender body from reference 2. Do NOT make a glossy 3D doll, a painterly illustration, a detailed anime portrait, watercolor hair, giant sparkly irises, or thin filigree costume detail. Keep the compact thick-outlined 2D sprite aesthetic of reference 1.
